manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.chocolate: Hot chocolate rolled into balls is the quickest thing here to eat, and what the cake is built from.
A plain bar is food on its own, and the base of everything wrapped.
Cocoa dust and milk in a bowl is cold chocolate, which is not much use on its own. Any milk bucket will do, including the ones Assorted Tools adds.
Chocolate balls and milk make a cake. It is placed and eaten a slice at a time, the way any cake is.
Ground down, cocoa beans give cocoa dust, which is the form every chocolate recipe actually asks for.
Heat the bowl in a furnace and it becomes hot chocolate. Everything below wants it hot.

Place the mould and right click it with hot chocolate to pour. It sets on its own over a while.

Once it has set, punch the mould to knock the bar out. The mould stays where it is, ready for the next pour.
Nine bars press into a block, and a block gives the nine back.
Make a wrapper, wrap a bar in it, and the result feeds you better than the bare bar did.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.but:
Right click the churn with any milk bucket to fill it, then punch it to churn. One filling gives one to three butter.

The bucket comes back, so a stack of milk is a stack of butter.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.che: A block of cheese cuts into nine pieces, and nine pieces press back into a block.

The cheese maker takes a milk bucket the same way, but it needs time. Watch it turn from pale to a yellow orange; punching it early gets you nothing.

When it has gone the whole way, punch it for a block of cheese.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dairy.hot: Melted cheese is the filling a burger wants, and better food than the cold piece was.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.dragon_fr: Cacti sometimes drop dragon fruit when they break. It is a small meal.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.eggs:
Crack eggs into a pan, mix them, then cook them in a furnace. Raw eggs are not worth eating, and the game will let you try anyway.

Cooked eggs are filling and heal well, which is most of the reason to keep butter around.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.knif: The knife slices bread and pumpkins. It stays in the crafting grid and wears out a little with every cut.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.mixe: The mixer whisks eggs, and wears out the same way the knife does.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.food.sand: Bread cuts into slices, and slices with cheese make a burger that carries a long trip.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.health.pa:
Food heals slowly and only while you are fed. These three heal now, which is what you want halfway through a fight.

The bandage is the cheap one, the health pack the middle, and the super pack needs powdered sweets from the previous chapter.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.baki: A raw pie bakes in a furnace, and the baked pie is a block. Place it down and eat it a slice at a time, the way a cake works.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.choc: Chocolate balls fill a pie too, and it bakes the same way.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.ingr: Every pie starts with dough in a pan. Pumpkin slices are the one filling you have to cut yourself.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.pies.raw: Make an empty pie, then fill it with apple, pumpkin, melon or pork. A raw pie is not food yet.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.soda.carb: Every soda starts the same way: a soda bottle, some carbon dioxide, and water to carbonate. Get that far and the flavour is the easy part.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.soda.type:
Ten flavours, and they do not heal the same. Slurm and root beer are light, apple and the two oranges are ordinary, and cocoa, golden apple and diamond are worth saving.

Spiked orange is the exception. It hurts whoever drinks it, which is the whole point of handing one to somebody else.
manual.assortedcuisine.chapter.sugar.swe:
Powdered sugar makes sweets, and powdered sweets make the stronger kind. Neither is a meal, but both stack deep and eat quickly.

Powdered sweets are also what the super health pack is built on.
manual.assortedcuisine.description: Cocoa, chocolate, dairy and everything else this mod gives you to cook, bottle and eat.
